standards_frameworks.name: Head Start Early Learning Outcomes Framework (48-60 months)
Common Core State Standards (Kindergarten Math & ELA)
C3 Framework for Social Studies (Grade K)

domains.description: Uppercase and lowercase letter glyphs, case-match pairs, confusable letter pairs, and visual vowel/typography recognition (strictly visual, no spelling).
Numerals 0-100 milestones, dice/dot subitizing, finger counting, five-frames, ten-frames, tally marks, ordinals, base-10 visuals, fractions, and visual operations.
Math operators, currency signs, punctuation marks, traffic/safety pictograms, accessibility/UI icons, and musical notation symbols.
2D plane shapes, 3D geometric solids, real-world 3D matches, spatial prepositions, symmetry, composite shapes, and visual patterns.
Core and extended color swatches, color mixing, visual attribute/measurement comparison pairs, seriation, measurement tools, and textures/materials.
US coins and bills, coin equivalencies, analog clocks (hour, half-hour, quarter-hour), times of day, calendar tools, and daily routine sequences.
Weather, seasons, sky and solar system, plant parts, animal kingdom and habitats, life cycles, five senses, body parts, landforms, and physical science.
Community helpers and tools, vehicles and transportation, community places, maps/geography, civic concepts, and US national symbols.
Facial expressions and nuanced SEL cues, classroom/STEM tools, musical instruments, healthy food groups, weather clothing, and everyday sorting objects.

tiers.criteria: High-salience everyday visuals: primary colors, basic 2D shapes, numerals 0-5, high-frequency uppercase letters, common animals, basic emotions, sunny/rainy.
Full uppercase A-Z, numerals 0-10, perceptual subitizing 1-5, 11 core colors, 8+ 2D shapes, 5 senses & body parts, 4 seasons, core community helpers, basic traffic/safety pictograms, AB patterns.

Full lowercase a-z & confusable pairs, numerals 11-20, conceptual subitizing 6-10, 3D solids, math operators, US coins, on-the-hour analog clocks, spatial prepositions, NGSS life cycles/habitats/forces, US national symbols, AAB/ABB/ABC patterns.

Numerals 21-100 milestones & skip-counting visuals, visual fractions, half-hour/quarter-hour clocks, US bills & coin combos, comparison symbols, extended polygons, symmetry, solar system, detailed animal classes, nuanced emotions, map compass directions.

visual_types.description: Single uppercase/lowercase letter or visual letter pair rendered as a clean typographic glyph.
Single numeral or multi-digit number milestone rendered as a clear digit glyph.
Countable visual representation such as dots, fingers, five-frames, ten-frames, dominoes, tally marks, base-10 blocks, or visual fractions.
Mathematical, punctuation, currency, or musical notation symbol.
2D plane figure, 3D geometric solid, rotated shape, composite shape, or symmetry diagram.
Solid color swatch, shade comparison, or visual color-mixing diagram.
Repeating or growing visual sequence using shapes, colors, or icons.
Analog or digital clock face showing a specific time or time-telling tool.
US coin, paper bill, or visual coin equivalency diagram.
Child-friendly illustration of a science, social studies, emotion, spatial, or everyday object concept.
Universal icon, traffic/safety sign, or UI/accessibility pictogram without English text.
Side-by-side visual contrast illustrating opposites, measurable attributes, or relative quantities.
